title: elytrigia ruthenica
intro: Elytrigia ruthenica, commonly known as Tufted Hairgrass, is a perennial grass species native to the Northern Hemisphere, particularly found in wetlands and riverbanks. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Asia, due to its potential health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elytrigia ruthenica include anti-edematous, anti-hypoxic, and anti-cancer effects, as well as cardiovascular and gastrointestinal protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
